data.content_ref: inline:The foundational artifacts 1a1676a83b2776903485db006361e048bc0c0d83362ab58558852c8824eee470, 0cb1951e1158a92715cb17c40483231dca6bb3fdfacfe0adf6b155132475e95d, and 4337209f57a617d289cb2f0654e0ab1e42d4b46e9bbd990d6df1a94f476035ed each independently shares mechanism via the same abstract parsing fallacy (confusing relative proximity with absolute rank) to infer 'first', whereas artifact 83e2d1f789323de9dc1153ab2f0454bfbae783969d5cfe3f7a4f3927a63df5db contradicts them all by applying standard ordinal semantics to conclude 'second'.
